name: brainweb-claude
description: Lets Claude see and drive the BrainWeb 3D neuroscience site open in your browser: show brain parts and scenes, read your lectures and create practice tests.
long_description:
BrainWeb is an interactive 3D neuroscience learning site (English and Hebrew). With this extension installed and BrainWeb open in your browser, Claude can see where you are on the site, take you to any place in the 3D drill-down (brain, regions, cells, molecules, research methods), read the lectures you added on the "AI test from a lecture" page, and write practice tests that open straight on the site.

The extension talks only to the BrainWeb page on your own computer, through a local connection (127.0.0.1, port 47321). Keep the BrainWeb tab open while you use it.

tools.name: brainweb_get_context
tools.description: See what is open in BrainWeb (page, place, selected part, language).

tools.name: brainweb_pair
tools.description: Pair the open BrainWeb page with Claude using the code it shows (once per browser).

tools.name: brainweb_list_places
tools.description: List every place and brain part BrainWeb can show.

tools.name: brainweb_show
tools.description: Navigate BrainWeb to a place, brain parts, a pathway or a route.

tools.name: brainweb_list_lectures
tools.description: List the lectures added on the AI-test page.

tools.name: brainweb_get_lecture_text
tools.description: Read the text of an added lecture.

tools.name: brainweb_create_test
tools.description: Create a bilingual practice test that opens on the site.

site_origin.title: BrainWeb web address (optional)
site_origin.description: Only if you use BrainWeb from a website other than ortal-libon.github.io/brainweb: its address, e.g. https://my-brainweb.netlify.app. Local addresses (localhost:5173) and the published site always work.
